title: HustleBox v1.0.1 — Official Branding
message:
The official HustleBox logo is in. Brushstroke wordmark, sun rising over the city skyline. The app icon, splash, and About screen all match now.

• Official HustleBox logo wired into the app
• Custom sun + skyline app icon (replaces placeholder)
• Logo appears in the desktop sidebar and About section
• Cache-clear-on-update logic verified — new logo will appear after one refresh

No gameplay changes in this version. Next update will start adding more job variety, the back room arcade, and the friends system.
